label: SLC3A2::NRG1

sections.text: SLC3A2 encodes CD98 heavy chain, a membrane component of amino-acid transport complexes.
NRG1 encodes neuregulin 1, a ligand for ERBB3/ERBB4 receptor signaling.

The fusion preserves the NRG1 EGF-like ligand domain and promotes ERBB3 signaling through ERBB2/ERBB3 receptor complexes. This is a ligand-driven oncogenic mechanism rather than a kinase fusion. SLC3A2::NRG1 has been detected in carcinomas.

Zenocutuzumab, a HER2/HER3 bispecific antibody, has US indications for adults with NRG1-fusion-positive advanced unresectable or metastatic NSCLC, pancreatic adenocarcinoma or cholangiocarcinoma after progression on prior systemic therapy.
